scientific_interpretation_lock: A8.2 shows that the strict X_candidate definition is not robust under corrected FDR sensitivity sweeps. Four units appear under the permissive uncorrected setting, but zero survive corrected sweep configurations. Therefore, X_candidate should not be promoted as a robust manuscript class under the current metric definition.

denominator_glossary.n_unique_units_global: Total number of unique unit keys (session_id, unit_axis_index) evaluated across all processed sessions.
denominator_glossary.n_raw_behavioral_trials: Number of raw behavioral trials recorded in a single condition session file.
denominator_glossary.total_x_candidates_robust: Total number of unique units that survive and are classified as X_candidate across 6 or more sweep configurations.
